newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen welcomes Service's bid withdrawal.
newsitem.headline: Loewen welcomes Service's bid withdrawal.

text.p: The Loewen Group on Tuesday said it welcomed a decision by Service Corp International to withdraw a hostile takeover bid.
"The Loewen Group Inc ...is pleased that Service Corporation International has decided to withdraw its hostile takeover bid," Loewen said in a statement.
Service Corp announced earlier Tuesday it had decided to withdraw its exchange offer for Loewen, which it had been pursuing since last September. It had offered $2.9 billion for the company.
Loewen described the decision as "good news for the industry, Loewen Group shareholders and consumers.
"With this distraction behind us, we look forward to continued implementation of our growth strategy in 1997," it said.
It said it was involved in acquisitions or structured transactions totalling $1.4 billion in 1996.
